chair: A seat for one person with a back, often supported by legs.

armchair: An upholstered chair with a back and armrests.

sofa: A long upholstered seat for several people with a back and armrests.

bench: A long seat for more than one person.

coffee table: A photo of a coffee table.
A low table usually placed in front of a sofa or seating area.

dining table: A photo of a dining table.
A table used for eating meals.

desk: A work table used for writing or using a computer.

side table: A photo of a side table.
A small table beside a chair, sofa, or bed.

cabinet: A storage unit with doors or drawers.

bookshelf: A shelving unit used to hold books and other objects.

TV stand: A photo of a tv stand.
A low furniture unit supporting a television or media equipment.

bed: A piece of furniture with a mattress used for sleeping.

nightstand: A small bedside cabinet or table.

wardrobe: A tall cabinet used to store clothing.

speaker: A photo of a speaker.
An audio loudspeaker with a box-shaped enclosure and sound-producing drivers, placed on the floor, furniture, or a stand.

subwoofer: A box-shaped loudspeaker designed to reproduce low-frequency bass sounds.

audio amplifier: A photo of a audio amplifier.
An electronic audio component with a rectangular enclosure, front controls, knobs, or a display.

television: A flat display screen used for watching television, often on furniture or mounted on a wall.

computer monitor: A photo of a computer monitor.
A display screen used with a computer, commonly supported by a desktop stand.

computer tower: A photo of a computer tower.
A rectangular desktop computer case containing computing hardware.

laptop: A portable computer with a hinged screen and keyboard.

keyboard: A panel of keys used to enter text into a computer.

mouse: A small hand-operated computer pointing device.

remote control: A photo of a remote control.
A handheld device with buttons for controlling electronic equipment.

projector: An optical electronic device with a lens that projects images onto a screen or wall.

floor lamp: A photo of a floor lamp.
A tall freestanding light fixture supported by a base on the floor.

table lamp: A photo of a table lamp.
A small light fixture placed on a table or cabinet.

ceiling light: A photo of a ceiling light.
A light fixture attached to or suspended from the ceiling.

potted plant: A photo of a potted plant.
A plant growing in a pot or planter.

vase: A decorative container often used to hold flowers.

book: A bound collection of pages with a cover.

bottle: A container with a narrow neck used to hold liquids.

cup: A small open drinking vessel, sometimes with a handle.

bowl: A round open container used to hold food or other contents.

plate: A shallow dish used to serve food.

cushion: A soft padded object placed on a seat or sofa.

curtain: A hanging fabric panel covering a window or opening.

rug: A separate textile covering laid on a floor.

mirror: A framed or unframed reflective panel.

framed picture: A photo of a framed picture.
A picture or artwork enclosed in a physical frame.

clock: A physical device displaying the time.

door: A movable panel used to open or close an entrance.

window: A glazed opening in a wall with a surrounding frame.

refrigerator: A large kitchen appliance with doors for keeping food cold.

oven: A kitchen appliance with an enclosed heated compartment for cooking.

microwave: A countertop or built-in appliance with a door and controls for heating food.

sink: A basin with a drain, often beneath a faucet.

toilet: A bathroom fixture with a bowl and seat.

bathtub: A large basin used for bathing.

washing machine: A photo of a washing machine.
An appliance with a drum and door used to wash clothes.

box: A rigid container with flat sides used for storage.

basket: An open container made from woven or perforated material.

backpack: A bag with shoulder straps designed to be carried on the back.

floor: The lower horizontal surface of a room.

wall: A vertical structural surface enclosing or dividing a room.

ceiling: The upper interior surface of a room.
